events.verdict: Thompson (GSW) maintains legal position and absorbs contact during Beverly's (LAC) drive.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds - Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: From the available angles, Beverly (LAC) throws the ball out of bounds without it being touched by Durant (GSW).
Curry (GSW) makes marginal contact with Bradley (LAC) but does not affect his ability to defend.
[Observable in enhanced video] Durant (GSW) splits his feet at the start of the dribble.
Green (GSW) is firming up in legal position during the screen with Beverly (LAC).
Bradley (LAC) legally contests and does not step into Durant's (GSW) landing area on his jump shot attempt.
Harrell (LAC) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he is imminently exiting.
Harris (LAC) engages with Durant (GSW) on the perimeter but does not affect his FOM.
Bradley (LAC) briefly places an arm around Durant (GSW) but slides it off as they disengage from the pick.
[Observable in enhanced video] Green (GSW) slides his pivot foot before the pass.
[Observable in enhanced video] Curry (GSW) lifts his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Curry (GSW) is firming up in legal position during the screen with Beverly (LAC).
Beverley (LAC) engages with Green (GSW) but doesn't affect his ability to get to the pass.
Harris (LAC) makes contact with Durant's (GSW) body during the follow-through on his jump shot but does not affect his ability to follow-through naturally.
Green (GSW) and Harrell (LAC) engage and disengage during the rebound.
LAR shows Durant (GSW) jumps vertically and makes marginal body contact as he tips the ball during Harris' (LAC) driving shot attempt.
Thompson (GSW) makes incidental contact with Bradley's (LAC) body during the follow-through on his dunk.
Beverly (LAC) makes marginal contact with Thompson (GSW) during the rebound but does not affect his ability to get to the ball.
Harrell (LAC) maintains a legal guarding position on Curry's (GSW) shot.
